method: The leads of the first 300 reports of anthropic-outlets, one lead for each request to the llama.cpp server (b11836) on the maintainer's Mac, as a host embeds them at sync time, after the fit, with no other run of this round. Memory: phys_footprint of the server (macOS footprint) and its resident set size (ps rss), after the requests. Both servers ran with -c 8192 -np 1 -t 2 -tb 2 -b 8192; EmbeddingGemma 2 with -ub 2048, Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B with -ub 8192 and --pooling last, as its model card gives.
